topReviews.title: Mechanical engineers
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: The repaired moving hinge is positive mechanism evidence, and continuing fine repairs supports functional making. Her dominant repeated interest is small joins and fine repair; designing machines or moving mechanisms as a continuing activity remains undifferentiated. Invite a mechanical trial without equating a jewelry-repair preference with every machine-design method.
topReviews.quote: she remade a broken doll hinge using thread, wire, and repeated attempts.
topReviews.followup: Would you choose improving another moving mechanism, making a secure decorative join, or investigating a biology question next? What part of the mechanism task would you want to repeat?

topReviews.title: Accountants and Auditors
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Purchase entries and correcting column errors support accurate records. The repeated motivation is primarily quantities, storage, growing and fewer wasted trips; investigating monetary accounts and learning financial reports/reporting rules is a plausible but distinct preference. Advanced-accounting unfamiliarity is not the reason for clarification.
topReviews.quote: She enjoyed that there was a physical thing to check against the number.
topReviews.followup: Would you prefer reconciling a money-payment discrepancy, checking stock against a supply list, or comparing plant growth? Would learning financial-report rules make the money task more or less interesting?

topReviews.title: Cost Estimators
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Repeated expenses, choosing stock amounts, quantities and explicitly wanting complete cost reasoning support learning detailed estimates rather than merely liking arithmetic. Plans, labor assumptions and revising forecasts are new methods within a credible interest in what a proposed activity will cost; no prior professional estimate is required.
topReviews.quote: I want to learn enough about money that I stop making big announcements before counting everything.
topReviews.followup: Would you try forecasting the full cost of a small sale before it starts, including time and supplies, or would you rather check records of a sale already completed?

topReviews.title: Environmental scientists & specialists
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Repeated organisms, rainfall and revised observations directly support biological field comparison. Investigating pollution and proposing harm prevention is a distinctive environmental aim not yet separated from understanding ordinary organism changes. This is an unresolved subject/goal question, not a rejection of unfamiliar sampling or a judgment about hearing access.
topReviews.quote: Take a more demanding biology class
topReviews.followup: Would you choose comparing ordinary organism changes, investigating a possible pollution source, or trying a biology explanation task? Would proposing ways to prevent harm be part of what attracts you?

topReviews.title: Elementary School Teachers
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: She voluntarily returns to bounded story sessions, enjoys inventing questions and adapts stories for young listeners. That is credible positive evidence for learning engaging child instruction and responsive support; it need not already include diagnosing schoolwork difficulties. Family care and guilt alone would not establish this interest, and protected boundaries remain important.
topReviews.quote: Adapts familiar stories for younger listeners
topReviews.followup: Would you choose a structured session helping an unfamiliar child understand a reading task, a story performance, or a literature discussion for yourself? Which parts would you want more or less of?

topReviews.title: Firefighters
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Repeated emergency-program drills, gear checks and radio practice support response-team exploration. Entering dangerous scenes for fire/rescue and providing aid to injured people are distinctive responsibilities not established by enjoying coordinated equipment exercises. Ask about wanting to learn those aims without requiring actual emergencies, unusual bravery or present first-aid competence.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to learn about dangerous-scene rescue and injured-person aid, or is the strongest attraction coordinated equipment/radio work? What supervised observation would help you compare them?

topReviews.title: Environmental scientists & specialists
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Long-term aquarium health, comparing possible causes of cloudy water with tests, and school tap-water samples provide concrete water-quality investigation and prevention context as well as measurement methods. Extending that to environmental causes and harm prevention is a credible learning direction; public presentations, advanced facilities and independent large studies are not prerequisites.
topReviews.quote: Wants to continue learning about water and living systems
topReviews.followup: Would you prefer investigating a possible water-quality problem and ways to prevent it, studying organism behavior, or comparing measurements without proposing an intervention?

topReviews.title: Bookkeeping, Accounting, & Auditing Clerks
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Recurring real sales, chosen inventory/cost tables and continuing costs/proceeds records give a direct money-record basis. Checking unfamiliar business entries and discrepancies is a reasonable extension of that domain rather than a requirement to have encountered accounting errors already. Attraction to listing images should still be compared with back-office records.
topReviews.quote: keeps a simple record of costs and proceeds
topReviews.followup: Would you rather spend a session reconciling sale proceeds with costs, improving listing photographs and captions, or comparing workplace routines? Which record-checking steps would you want to learn?

topReviews.title: Physician · family medicine
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Medical causes of similar symptoms, health-source checking, chosen biology and actively exploring physician training together provide domain-specific support for a medical learning invitation. Treatment responsibility is a genuine open exposure question, but lack of patient examination or clinical responsibility does not negate the supported interest. No diagnostic aptitude or willingness to perform every future duty is inferred.
topReviews.quote: Ari is looking into Texas college science programs and what medical school and residency actually involve.
topReviews.followup: Would observing a consultation and discussing diagnosis and ongoing treatment choices interest you, or are explanation/research tasks currently more attractive? What would you want to learn about responsibility for patients?

topReviews.title: Environmental scientists & specialists
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Pond observations and repeated explanations directly support ecological observation and science communication. Pollution investigation and preventing environmental harm are a distinct aim still inferred from general living-systems curiosity. Keep environmental science available as a trial without treating it as already as specific as the observation/communication interests.
topReviews.followup: Would you choose investigating a possible pollution effect, comparing ordinary pond changes, or designing an explanatory diagram? Would developing a harm-prevention recommendation interest you too?

topReviews.title: Web & Digital Interface Designers
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Repeated wayfinding labels and watching users misunderstand directions support usability and visual communication. Designing digital-screen controls and testing website navigation is a plausible new medium, but no chosen digital-interface problem distinguishes that specific preference yet. This is not a requirement to know code or already have designed a website.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to revise a confusing webpage with a user, redesign a physical sign, or draw a route? What would make the digital task interesting or uninteresting?

topReviews.title: Interpreters and Translators
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: She independently enjoys comparing how relatives tell the same joke and reads both languages; that is positive cross-language meaning/tone evidence beyond simply having a bilingual background. Learning to convey someone else's message accurately is a credible extension. Professional fluency, client interpreting and instantaneous delivery are not assumed.
topReviews.followup: Would you enjoy translating a short joke or message for another person while preserving its tone, or do you prefer comparing wording privately? Would spoken, written or neither form attract you?

topReviews.title: Graphic Designers
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: She liked redesigning a real pickup sheet after an order mistake, clarifying names and quantities for its users. That directly grounds audience-focused visual information and purposeful revision. Broader visual styles and tools can be learned, while the family-business task need not become an unlimited obligation.
topReviews.followup: Would you choose revising a form or visual message for an unfamiliar group, making a music recording, or testing a soil question? Which design decisions would you want to try yourself?

topReviews.title: Mechanical engineers
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Dismantling and labeling a fan and documenting tests supply a mechanical bridge, but ongoing chosen projects center on circuits, lighting and accessible demonstrations. Machine/moving-part design is not yet distinguished from electrical controls or explaining equipment. Offer a mechanism project without discounting interest because machine-shop tools are unfamiliar.
topReviews.followup: Would you choose improving a moving mechanism, testing an electrical/lighting control, or preparing a demonstration? What would attract you to the mechanism task independently of presenting it?

topReviews.title: Industrial designers
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: He repeatedly chooses useful sewn objects and personal commissions, cares who will use a finished object and attends to preferences. This supports exploring user-oriented physical products and learning model revision without already having formal user-testing experience. Production-time refunds show limits on order volume, not disinterest in design; avoid replacing his craft preferences with parental engineering expectations.
topReviews.quote: making fabric covers and instruction cards for the kit
topReviews.followup: Would you like to sketch and revise a fabric object around another person's needs, make an unconstrained personal patch, or try a different material? Which requested changes would be interesting to solve?
